'''Primitive Summoners''', known internally as '''Canra''', is a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive Tier]].

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
*Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when an [[Adapted Summoner]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Primitive Summoners are Backline Utility/Melee Support Combatants (Summoners).

*Primitive Summoners' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Primitive Summoners can perform the following abilities:
**Summon 2 [[Rupter|Rupters]] through the usage of [[Biomass]].
***This has a 10 second cooldown.
***A maximum of 4 Rupters can be active at a time. 
***The summoned Rupters will spawn with the [[Rage]] Effect and will always seek to stay near the Primitive Summoner, regardless of distance.
**Slowly approach their target and then vomit purple particles and produce a green effect cloud in front of them. This attack has a 12 second cooldown. Summoners will often follow this action with an attack.
***This effect cloud inflicts [[Viral]], [[Corrosion]], Weakness, Hunger, and [[Vomit]], all for 15 seconds. 
**Revive Parasites if the fallen Parasite's large [[Remains|Remain]] piece is present.
*Primitive Summoners will keep their distance from their enemies.
*Primitive Summoners have a chance of blocking incoming damage, nullifying it.
*Primitive Summoners can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
*Primitive Summoners can dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Primitive Summoners can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 1, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.
*On death, Primitive Summoners have a chance to explode, releasing Primitive Remains and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.
*If a Primitive Summoner gets 10 kills, it will evolve into an [[Adapted Summoner]].
{{Variants|count=3|Berserker=BerserkerPriSummoner.png|Virulent=VirulentPriSummoner.png|Breacher=BreacherPriSummoner.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Primitive Summoners, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.{{Properties
|tier=Primitive
|OrbEffectsMobs=Hunger II (00:15)
|OrbEffectsParasites=Speed II (00:30)
}}

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Primitive Summoners have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Primitive Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Summoners will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.
